posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
With rpgmakercentral down I realised one of the best cars out there is not available anymore and that is a shame. WBRUH/A.M.'s terms say nothing about reposting, but since they are pretty loose I hope it is okay for them that I make them accessible here again.
Normally I do not like reposting other people's resources, but it seems to be cool with the terms and they are after all those years still one of my favourite car resource that you can also plug and play use in MV and MZ due to their handy size.
Here are the full terms as they come in the folder of the restaff they were released with:
- Always credit "A.M'.
- Free RPG Maker use
- Free to edit
- Do not sell as own.
(\_/)
(' ^ ')
(> <)o
Click to expand...
